about: Listed companies with sourced ties to each frontier lab, how strong each tie is (this site's 1-3 rating with its reason, from data/pathways.json), whether shareholders can reach the company, and its reported holders. Ordered by what the records show (a listed lab first, then the strongest ties); not a forecast of influence and not a recommendation.

routes.how_to_file: A shareholder of record can bring a proposal with notice 90 to 120 days before the anniversary of the last annual meeting; the bylaws treat June 19, 2026 as the date of the 2026 meeting. Musk and his permitted transferees are exempt from these notice rules.
routes.threshold: At least $1 million in market value or 3% of voting shares, held for six months before and through the meeting (bylaws Section 2.5, adopted June 15, 2026, under Texas Section 21.373).
routes.control: Class A shares carry one vote and Class B shares carry ten. Musk reported sole voting power over about 0.85 billion Class A shares and 5.57 billion Class B shares (3.92 billion held in trusts, 1.30 billion restricted and 0.35 billion under options) as of June 30, 2026. 8.25 billion Class A and 5.33 billion Class B shares were outstanding on October 15, 2026. No proxy statement yet. From these figures Musk holds about 86% to 87% of total votes (86% without the options, 87% with them; this site's calculation, mixing June 30 holdings with October 15 share counts; the filings do not state a percentage).
